summary: Corteva and EIDP filed an 8-K reporting that 15 states and one sovereign sued in the U.S. District Court for the Southern District of Indiana on October 1, 2026, challenging Corteva's completed separation into Corteva and Vylor Inc. (the U.S. equivalent of a spin-off). A temporary restraining order issued October 9 barred non-ordinary-course asset disposals, dividends and buybacks; the District Court stayed it October 10 pending a Seventh Circuit emergency stay motion. The separation closed October 1, 2026. Watch how the appeal affects capital returns and Vylor's stand-alone flexibility.
